metrics_desc.top1_acc: Top-1 accuracy (fraction of operators where the first predicted type equals ground truth).
metrics_desc.top3_acc: Top-3 accuracy (ground truth appears within the first 3 predicted types).
metrics_desc.top5_acc: Top-5 accuracy (ground truth appears within the first 5 predicted types).
metrics_desc.main_dist_coverage: Share of operators whose predicted probability vector equals (rounded to 1e-3) the most frequent vector.
metrics_desc.mean_js_to_main: Mean Jensen-Shannon divergence between each predicted probability vector and the most frequent vector (lower = more homogeneous).
